evaluation_tasks.prompt: A client presents a 10-page list of 40 features for a 'version 1' pet-walking booking app. Walk them through a MoSCoW prioritization to identify the minimal viable cut.
pass_criteria: Limits 'Must Have' list to 3-5 core capabilities (e.g. Find walker, Book slot, Process payment).
Relegates nice-to-haves (e.g. GPS live tracking, pet social feed, rewards store) to Could/Won't Have.
Explains the trade-offs in clear business terms (speed to market, testing core hypothesis).
Outputs a structured PRD conforming to `prd.schema.json`.
fail_criteria: Fails to establish explicit 'Won't Have' boundaries.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Draft user stories with acceptance criteria for a user changing their account email address.
pass_criteria: Covers happy path (confirmation email sent to new address with secure token).
Covers negative path (email already in use, invalid email format, expired token).
Specifies notification sent to old email address for security alert.
fail_criteria: Writes vague criteria without boundary conditions.
Omits confirmation verification step before updating email.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Define the Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) and kill criteria for an automated invoice reminder feature.
pass_criteria: Frames JTBD using standard 'When / I want to / So I can' format.
Defines clear quantifiable metric (e.g. % of overdue invoices collected within 7 days).
Defines an unambiguous kill criteria threshold (e.g. if fewer than 10% of users enable it or complaint rate > 2%).
